information_time_rationale: One reconstruction time for both count states and pool forms, after the displayed Nov9 release and latest known PDF producer activity (Nov9 19:04:53 Pacific in the press copy). Conservative research convention, not an authenticated historical publication timestamp. The Nov8 AMENDED form is not backdated to its face time.
scope: Single-seat city candidate contests in the listed whole-county cities and County Supervisor 1st District. Exclude ties/unopposed, measures/multiseat, unreviewed school/special districts and county slices of state/federal offices. Selection uses as-of identity and ballot instruction, not final margin or reversal.
weights: Equal contests within the single held-out county/election. Three queue scenarios are sensitivities, not independent additional observations. All methods score the same base rows.
grouping: Both cumulative snapshots, all contests and all scenarios belong to ca:orange:2024-general; no split or training reuse. The older King experiment stays a distinct assumption stratum and is not relabeled training.
chronology_disclosure: Source bytes and public final outcomes were inspected for identity/count qualification before freeze. Regression checks generated as-of subset predictions without outcomes or losses. Frozen computational reconstruction, not blind preregistration or forecasts published in 2024. No real OC losses inspected before this freeze.
outcome_definition: Selected as-of second-place named candidate strictly exceeds the selected as-of leader in the original officially delegated final summary CSV. Final ties are not strict reversals. Not whole-winner or latest-recount adjudication.
calibration: Ten equal-width probability bins, diagnostic only. One county/election supplies no independent calibration or geographic confidence interval. Binary probabilities do not define supported predictive intervals.
pool_assumptions: Base assumes all 212152 estimated unprocessed ballots become countable with the same countywide geographic/pair fraction as counted votes. Lower accepts 80%; separate_challenged adds all separately reported challenges assuming zero overlap and full acceptance. Future arrivals excluded as a scenario condition, not asserted zero or bounded.
batch_sensitivity: Primary likelihood has zero verified latest votes. Reported-increment-only and disjoint-increment comparisons condition on no corrections in compatible tally changes. They do not reclassify operational deltas or prove that assumption.
qualification: Official dated queue estimates, with assumed acceptance and geographic/pair participation; not official contest-specific countable remaining votes. No future-arrival upper bound. Reported-increment models additionally assume no corrections within the tally change. Current archive bytes are not authenticated historical captures. Reconstructed after public outcomes; not a blind experiment, published historical forecast, calibration or production eligibility.
promotion_policy: No operational eligibility, calibrated forecast or audit closure follows solely from these scores; EA-10/EA-13 residual evidence and independent parent review remain explicit.
